design_systems.name: Swiss Grid Editorial
design_systems.description: Disciplined modular grid, whitespace, precise alignment and editorial typography.
design_systems.geometry: Asymmetric grid-aligned columns, hairline rules, numbered sections and rectangular regions.
design_systems.typography: Editorial headings, restrained sans-serif body and compact metadata.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Align charts and diagrams to a shared baseline and column grid.
design_systems.prompt: Use a disciplined modular grid, generous whitespace, precise alignment, restrained accents, thin dividers and editorial typography. Align charts and diagrams to the grid.

design_systems.name: Executive Corporate
design_systems.description: Decision-oriented layouts with KPI strips, consistent headers and concise evidence blocks.
design_systems.geometry: Consistent header/footer, KPI strips, metric cards and balanced columns.
design_systems.typography: Strong executive headlines and readable sans-serif body.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Clean charts, KPI cards and evidence-to-action blocks.
design_systems.prompt: Use a clean corporate grid, consistent headers, restrained navy and neutrals, KPI cards and decision-oriented layouts. Prioritize credibility and readability.

design_systems.name: Engineering Blueprint
design_systems.description: Technical drawing language with dimension lines, leaders, callouts and precise diagram frames.
design_systems.geometry: Drawing frames, section markers, dimension arrows, coordinate axes and numbered callouts.
design_systems.typography: Technical sans-serif with monospaced metadata and legible labels.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Diagram-first orthographic panels, exploded views and annotated figures.
design_systems.prompt: Use precise technical geometry, dimension lines, leaders, numbered callouts and consistent line weights. Preserve measurements and units exactly; never fabricate specifications.

design_systems.name: Technical Dark / Neon
design_systems.description: High-contrast dark panels with restrained cyan, electric-blue or violet accents.
design_systems.geometry: Dark cards, network nodes, data-flow connectors and thin borders.
design_systems.typography: High-contrast sans-serif headings and compact technical labels.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Crisp node-link diagrams and directional flows; restrained effects.
design_systems.prompt: Use a deep charcoal canvas, crisp high-contrast panels, restrained neon accents, system diagrams, network nodes and precise labels. Keep effects subtle.

design_systems.name: Bento Grid
design_systems.description: Modular cards with varied sizes and clear content grouping.
design_systems.geometry: Unequal modular cards, consistent gutters and generous padding.
design_systems.typography: Bold compact card titles and concise body text.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Group related metrics, diagrams and explanations into independent modules.
design_systems.prompt: Use a modular bento grid with varied card sizes, consistent gutters, rounded containers and clear grouping. Give each card one message.

design_systems.name: Minimalist Scandinavian
design_systems.description: Light neutral canvas, restrained color, whitespace and simple geometry.
design_systems.geometry: Open layouts, simple blocks, subtle separators and generous margins.
design_systems.typography: Clean sans-serif, restrained weights and comfortable line spacing.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Simple flat diagrams with minimal decoration.
design_systems.prompt: Use a light neutral canvas, generous whitespace, restrained accents, simple geometry and clean typography. Remove decoration that does not aid comprehension.

design_systems.name: Neo-Brutalist
design_systems.description: Bold blocks, thick outlines, hard offset shadows and high-contrast typography.
design_systems.geometry: Rectangular blocks, thick borders, hard offset shadows and asymmetric compositions.
design_systems.typography: Heavy display headings and concise supporting text.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Bold simple diagrams with strong outlines.
design_systems.prompt: Use bold rectangular blocks, thick dark outlines, hard offset shadows and strong typography. Keep diagrams simple and legible.

design_systems.name: Architecture & Materiality
design_systems.description: Spatial composition inspired by concrete, timber, glass, plans and material samples.
design_systems.geometry: Large drawing zones, material swatches, section bands and calm asymmetry.
design_systems.typography: Elegant headings with clear technical captions.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Plans, sections, elevations, material boards and spatial annotations.
design_systems.prompt: Use architectural editorial language, material-inspired neutrals, spatial balance, plan-like grids and clear section drawings.

design_systems.name: Data Visualization / Analytical
design_systems.description: Evidence-led layouts prioritizing charts, scales, labels, comparisons and sources.
design_systems.geometry: Chart-first panels, aligned axes, compact legends and annotation zones.
design_systems.typography: Numerically clear labels, strong chart titles and compact source notes.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Accurate charts and tables with units, axes, series and sources.
design_systems.prompt: Prioritize accurate data visualization. Preserve values and units, label axes and series, use restrained gridlines and clear legends. Never invent data.

design_systems.name: Isometric / Exploded View
design_systems.description: Layered spatial component views with separation, numbered parts and assembly logic.
design_systems.geometry: Isometric groupings, separated layers and component callouts.
design_systems.typography: Compact technical labels and readable descriptions.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Exploded component relationships and assembly order.
design_systems.prompt: Use an isometric or exploded-view composition with separated components, numbered callouts and visible assembly relationships. Do not invent dimensions.

design_systems.name: Process Flow / Chevron
design_systems.description: Directional stages, transitions, inputs, outputs and decision points.
design_systems.geometry: Aligned process blocks, directional connectors, decision diamonds and stage bands.
design_systems.typography: Short action-led labels and concise descriptions.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Make sequence direction, branches, inputs and outputs unmistakable.
design_systems.prompt: Use a clear left-to-right process flow with aligned stages, directional connectors, explicit decisions, inputs and outputs.

design_systems.name: Timeline / Roadmap
design_systems.description: Chronological milestones, phases, dependencies and delivery checkpoints.
design_systems.geometry: Timeline, milestone markers, phase bands and dependency lines.
design_systems.typography: Date-first labels and concise milestone descriptions.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Preserve chronology and distinguish milestones, durations and dependencies.
design_systems.prompt: Use a structured timeline with clear milestones, phases, dates and dependencies. Preserve chronology; do not invent dates.

design_systems.name: Comparison Matrix
design_systems.description: Side-by-side evaluation with criteria, trade-offs and recommendation emphasis.
design_systems.geometry: Aligned comparison columns, criterion rows and highlighted decision cells.
design_systems.typography: Clear row labels and compact cell text.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Compare like-for-like criteria and distinguish facts from judgments.
design_systems.prompt: Use a precise comparison matrix with aligned criteria, balanced columns, readable labels and explicit trade-offs. Do not fabricate scores.

design_systems.name: Scientific Research / Academic
design_systems.description: Evidence hierarchy with methods, results, figures, limitations and citations.
design_systems.geometry: Figure panels, method/result sections, caption zones and citation footer.
design_systems.typography: Formal readable hierarchy with compact captions and references.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Separate method, observation, interpretation and limitation.
design_systems.prompt: Use scientific editorial style with methods, results, figures, captions, citations and limitations. Separate evidence from interpretation.

design_systems.name: Futuristic HUD / Systems Interface
design_systems.description: Instrument-panel framing, technical readouts, node maps and restrained interface detailing.
design_systems.geometry: Framed panels, segmented headers, fine rules and structured readout zones.
design_systems.typography: Technical micro-labels paired with legible main text.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: System maps and readouts with consistent status semantics; no fake telemetry.
design_systems.prompt: Use a futuristic systems-interface aesthetic with framed panels, fine technical rules and restrained accents. Never invent telemetry or status.

design_systems.name: Blueprint CAD Grid
design_systems.description: Deep technical drafting canvas with orthogonal hairlines, registration crosshairs and an engineering title block.
design_systems.geometry: Hollow drafting border, 4 vertical and 2 horizontal hairlines, bottom-right title stamp.
design_systems.typography: Monospace/geometric sans, 24pt bold ALL-CAPS header, 15pt technical bullets.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Specification-driven bullets prefixed with parameter tags such as [LOAD] and [SPEC].
design_systems.prompt: Format slides as technical CAD schematics: concise, specification-driven bullet points prefixed with parameter tags. Keep bullets under 12 words.

design_systems.name: Cyberpunk HUD Telemetry Frame
design_systems.description: Chamfered octagonal tactical display with corner brackets and neon edge illumination.
design_systems.geometry: Octagon/snipped-rectangle HUD container, overlapping hexagon header pill, three telemetry bars.
design_systems.typography: 22pt bold header in the hexagon, 16pt crisp sans-serif readout inside the frame.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Mission-control tone with subsystem headers and 3-5 high-signal metrics.
design_systems.prompt: Adopt a mission-control telemetry tone. Structure each slide with a system subsystem header and 3-5 high-signal operational metrics.

design_systems.name: Executive KPI Strip
design_systems.description: Three equal metric cards with accent caps above a unified synthesis panel.
design_systems.geometry: Header banner, three rounded metric cards at x 0.8/4.816/8.833, accent caps, bottom analysis panel.
design_systems.typography: 32pt bold metric callout per card, 16pt analytical body in the lower panel.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Lead with quantifiable KPIs and benchmarks, followed by concise analytical takeaways.
design_systems.prompt: Lead every slide with 3 quantifiable KPIs or structural benchmarks followed by 3 concise analytical takeaways.

design_systems.name: Chevron Process Flow
design_systems.description: Interlocking chevron phases with aligned vertical detail columns below each stage.
design_systems.geometry: Four chevrons at y=1.7in, four rounded detail columns at y=3.0in.
design_systems.typography: 16pt bold centered phase titles, 14pt left-aligned deliverables.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Three to four sequential phases with actionable deliverables or gate criteria.
design_systems.prompt: Organize the slide into 3 to 4 sequential engineering phases. Format each bullet as Phase Name: Actionable deliverable or gate criterion.

design_systems.name: Dual Comparison Matrix
design_systems.description: Symmetrical split-screen with a central VS badge separating two technical states.
design_systems.geometry: Left baseline panel, right target panel, central 0.8in VS oval badge.
design_systems.typography: 20pt bold column headers, 16pt paired comparison bullets.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Balanced, parallel bullet points for both sides of a binary comparison.
design_systems.prompt: Structure content as a direct binary comparison. Provide balanced, parallel bullet points for both sides.

design_systems.name: Swiss Grid Editorial (Pareto)
design_systems.description: Asymmetric 1/3 to 2/3 editorial layout with razor-thin structural rules and generous negative space.
design_systems.geometry: Top rule, vertical spine divider, left title zone, right tinted content zone.
design_systems.typography: 30pt bold title at left, 17pt generous 1.3x-spaced prose at right.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Complete analytical statements aligned to the structural grid.
design_systems.prompt: Write in an authoritative, editorial research tone. Use complete, well-crafted analytical statements rather than fragmented shorthand.

design_systems.name: Neo-Brutalist Structural Pop
design_systems.description: Sharp rectangular cards with thick solid borders and hard-offset solid drop shadows.
design_systems.geometry: Hard offset shadow, foreground card with 3.5pt border, header tag.
design_systems.typography: 24pt heavy bold header, 17pt high-contrast bullets with generous paragraph spacing.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Punchy, high-conviction structural claims and decisive outcomes.
design_systems.prompt: Use punchy, high-conviction engineering statements. Eliminate filler words; focus on bold structural claims and decisive outcomes.

design_systems.name: Glassmorphism Layered Card
design_systems.description: Floating rounded translucent card with luminescent border and a vertical accent pill.
design_systems.geometry: Two ambient ovals, primary glass container, left indicator pill.
design_systems.typography: 26pt bold title beside the pill, 17pt clean sans-serif bullets.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Four bullets maximum, each focused on a distinct architectural layer.
design_systems.prompt: Present clean, modular system concepts. Limit to 4 bullets per slide, each focusing on a distinct architectural layer or capability.

design_systems.name: Bento Grid Dashboard
design_systems.description: Asymmetric modular tile grid with a tall hero tile and two stacked horizontal tiles.
design_systems.geometry: Left hero tile 5.6x5.3, top-right tile 5.883x2.5, bottom-right tile 5.883x2.5.
design_systems.typography: 20pt bold tile headers, 15pt concise bullets across three compartments.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Group content into core architecture, performance metrics and edge constraints.
design_systems.prompt: Group slide content into 3 distinct functional clusters: Core Architecture, Performance Metrics, and Edge Constraints.

design_systems.name: Isometric Layer Stack
design_systems.description: Vertically stacked isometric diamond planes linked by callout lines to a specification card.
design_systems.geometry: Three diamonds at x=1.1 and y=1.7/3.1/4.5, connector bars, right specification card.
design_systems.typography: 15pt bold layer labels in diamonds, 16pt detailed specifications on the right.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Three-tier vertical stack with corresponding specifications for every tier.
design_systems.prompt: Structure the slide as a 3-tier vertical stack with corresponding specifications for each tier.

design_systems.name: Oversized Number Watermark
design_systems.description: Massive architectural index numeral behind a crisp foreground specification card.
design_systems.geometry: 180pt background numeral in a 5x5.8in frame, foreground rounded card at x=3.2.
design_systems.typography: 180pt bold watermark, 28pt bold title, 17pt bullets in the foreground card.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: One core engineering pillar with a clear thesis and three supporting proofs.
design_systems.prompt: Frame this slide around a single core engineering pillar or numbered milestone. Provide a clear thesis statement followed by 3 supporting proofs.

design_systems.name: Minimalist Timeline Milestone Bar
design_systems.description: Horizontal axis with circular milestone nodes and alternating above/below callouts.
design_systems.geometry: Axis spine at y=4.15, four milestone nodes, alternating callout cards above/below.
design_systems.typography: 15pt bold date/phase headers, 13.5pt milestone deliverables.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Four chronological milestones with time markers and concrete deliverables.
design_systems.prompt: Provide 4 chronological milestones or project gates. Format each bullet with a time marker and concrete engineering deliverable.

design_systems.name: Concentric Circle Target / Reach
design_systems.description: Three nested concentric circles illustrating core-to-periphery architecture with legend cards.
design_systems.geometry: Outer 4.8in ring, middle 3.3in ring, 1.8in core, three right-hand legend cards.
design_systems.typography: 18pt bold zone titles, 14.5pt technical scope descriptions.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Three concentric zones: Inner Core, Operational Perimeter, Outer Boundary.
design_systems.prompt: Categorize the system into 3 concentric zones of influence or containment: Inner Core, Operational Perimeter, and Outer Boundary.

design_systems.name: Frosted Sidebar Navigation
design_systems.description: Full-height vertical navigation rail with section metadata beside a spacious working canvas.
design_systems.geometry: 3.8in left rail, active section indicator, right content container at 4.3in.
design_systems.typography: 24pt bold rail title, 17pt structured operational checklist.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: Structured SOP or compliance audit with verifiable engineering criteria.
design_systems.prompt: Format as a structured technical SOP or compliance audit slide with a clear section title and 4-5 verifiable engineering criteria.

design_systems.name: Radial Sunburst Hub
design_systems.description: Central octagonal hub connected by radiating spoke bars to four corner satellite cards.
design_systems.geometry: Central 2.2in hub, four 4.1x2.1in corner cards, four thin connector bars.
design_systems.typography: 18pt bold hub title, 15pt node headers, 13.5pt node specifications.
design_systems.diagram_treatment: One orchestrator hub with four peripheral subsystems exchanging data or energy.
design_systems.prompt: Define a central system orchestrator/hub and 4 peripheral subsystems or interfaces that exchange data or energy with the core.
